meta.title: Skill Picker · 技能选择器
meta.description: 按开发阶段浏览技能目录，用中文或英文搜索，把选中的技能以 /name 插入输入框，并能在面板内安装新技能。 / Browses the host skill catalog by lifecycle phase, inserts the picked skills as /name, and installs new ones from a repo, URL, pasted SKILL.md, or the skills.sh registry.
